scope_notes: Covers the TensorRT-LLM v1.2.1 PUBLIC config surface a benchmark caller can plausibly touch. v1.x is a MAJOR-VERSION jump from 0.21; the class tree was reorganised. Key structural change: the AOT TRT-engine path was demoted and the PyTorch backend became the default. At v0.21 LlmArgs aliased TrtLlmArgs (llm_args.py:1594); at v1.2.1 LlmArgs aliases TorchLlmArgs (llmapi/llm_args.py:3410). BaseLlmArgs is now the explicit common base and BOTH TrtLlmArgs(BaseLlmArgs) and TorchLlmArgs(BaseLlmArgs) subclass it directly (no shared-then-aliased indirection).
Citations use 1-based line numbers as displayed by Read against /tmp/trial_tensorrt_v1_2_1_venv/src/tensorrt_llm/. Paths are RELATIVE to the tensorrt_llm package root.
Field 'type' uses JSON-schema-ish lowercase strings. Literal/StrEnum allowlists appear as 'enum'. Opaque objects encode as {'type':'object','description':<repr>}.

Pydantic migration: at v0.21 several config classes were stdlib @dataclass (BuildConfig, QuantConfig, LoraConfig) or metaclass-driven (PluginConfig). At v1.2.1 BuildConfig (builder.py:453), PluginConfig (plugin/plugin.py:88) and LoraConfig (lora_helper.py:82) are all pydantic BaseModel. QuantConfig (models/modeling_utils.py:131) remains a stdlib @dataclass. SamplingParams + GuidedDecodingParams remain @dataclass(slots=True, kw_only=True).

PluginConfig is NO LONGER metaclass-generated. v0.21 used PluginConfigMeta synthesising properties from '_'-prefixed storage fields. v1.2.1 declares plain pydantic fields with model_config=ConfigDict(validate_assignment=True, extra='ignore'). 'auto' resolution moved to __getattribute__ (plugin/plugin.py:297-308): reading a field whose stored value is 'auto' returns self.dtype. dtype cannot be 'auto' (validator plugin/plugin.py:310-315). enable/disable strings coerce to bool/None via a wildcard before-validator (plugin/plugin.py:317-329).

PybindMirror pattern persists and EXPANDED. v1.2.1 mirror-decorated classes: DynamicBatchConfig (_DynamicBatchConfig), SchedulerConfig (_SchedulerConfig), PeftCacheConfig (_PeftCacheConfig), LookaheadDecodingConfig (_LookaheadDecodingConfig), KvCacheConfig (_KvCacheConfig), ExtendedRuntimePerfKnobConfig (_ExtendedRuntimePerfKnobConfig), CacheTransceiverConfig (_CacheTransceiverConfig). Plus three mirror-decorated ENUMS: BatchingType, CapacitySchedulerPolicy, ContextChunkingPolicy (llmapi/llm_args.py:1410-1436). The decorator (llmapi/llm_args.py:1270-1298) asserts every C++ field has a Python counterpart at class-creation time, so the Python class is provably a superset of the C++ field surface at this pin.

BaseLlmArgs._check_consistency (llmapi/llm_args.py:2179-2195) asserts executor_config_attrs.issubset(llm_args_attr) (note: now a SUBSET assertion in the opposite direction, with max_beam_width black-listed). This bounds the catalogue's completeness claim.

Speculative-decoding tree EXPANDED from 6 to 9 concrete config classes: MedusaDecodingConfig, EagleDecodingConfig (now also handles Eagle3 in-place via eagle3_one_model/eagle3_layers_to_capture/eagle3_model_arch; NO separate Eagle3Config class - the v0.21 'replacement-with-torch.speculative.Eagle3Config' mechanism is GONE), NGramDecodingConfig, DraftTargetDecodingConfig, MTPDecodingConfig, LookaheadDecodingConfig (Pybind-mirrored), plus THREE NEW: SaveHiddenStatesDecodingConfig, UserProvidedDecodingConfig, AutoDecodingConfig. DecodingBaseConfig grew from 2 to ~11 fields. Backend dispatch is now via supports_backend() methods on each subclass rather than isinstance-replacement in the parent validator.

NEW config classes with no v0.21 analogue: CudaGraphConfig (replaces v0.21 flat cuda_graph_* TorchLlmArgs fields), GuidedDecodingConfig, MoeConfig, MoeLoadBalancerConfig (was a torch-internal type at v0.21, now top-level), Nvfp4GemmConfig, AttentionDpConfig, RayPlacementConfig, KvCacheConnectorConfig, and the sparse-attention tree (BaseSparseAttentionConfig + RocketSparseAttentionConfig + DeepSeekSparseAttentionConfig + SkipSoftmaxAttentionConfig).

C++ pybind boundary SCOPE CALL for v1.2.1: tensorrt_llm.bindings (shipped as bindings.cpython-3xx .so, stub bindings/__init__.pyi 923 lines, 18 classes) remains OUT OF SCOPE for the same reason as v0.21: every C++ runtime-config class that a LLM-API caller reaches has a @PybindMirror.mirror_pybind_fields Python BaseModel that is asserted (at class-creation) to be a field-superset of the C++ class. The Python mirror is therefore authoritative. Raw tensorrt_llm.bindings.executor.ExecutorConfig is constructed internally from BaseLlmArgs, not user-constructed, and _check_consistency guards the coverage. Decision: EXCLUDE the raw pybind classes; the Python mirror surface (catalogued here) supersedes them. Same risk/mitigation as v0.21 (a C++-only field added without a mirror breaks the decorator assertion, surfacing the gap).

GenerationConfig: TRT-LLM still does NOT define its own GenerationConfig class at v1.2.1 (grep '^class GenerationConfig' under tensorrt_llm/ returns nothing). Request-time decoding lives in SamplingParams; build-time geometry in BuildConfig. Unchanged from v0.21.

AdditionalModelOutput class is GONE at v1.2.1. SamplingParams.additional_model_outputs is now Optional[List[str]] (sampling_params.py:139), not Optional[List[AdditionalModelOutput]]. The additional_model_output_params namespace from the v0.21 GT is therefore dropped.

Pydantic field 'status' tag: many BaseLlmArgs/TorchLlmArgs fields carry json_schema_extra status='beta'/'prototype'/'deprecated'. TorchLlmArgs.warn_on_unstable_feature_usage (llmapi/llm_args.py:3215-3233) warns when a set field is beta/prototype. Recorded per-field as 'status'.

engine_params_base._note: Pydantic BaseModel (StrictBaseModel subclass) with model_config={'arbitrary_types_allowed':True,'extra':'forbid'} (line 1889-1892). Shared base for TrtLlmArgs and TorchLlmArgs.

model.description: Path or HF Hub name. Union[str, Path].

custom_tokenizer._note: NEW at v1.2.1. Alias 'deepseek_v32' or import path; loaded in validate_and_init_tokenizer (line 2256).

gpus_per_node.normalisation: If RAY_LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE set -> tensor_parallel_size; elif None -> torch.cuda.device_count() with warning.

pp_partition._note: NEW at v1.2.1. Per-rank layer count.

load_format._note: TorchLlmArgs OVERRIDES this to Union[str, LoadFormat] (line 2878).

lora_config._note: v0.21 deprecated scalars max_lora_rank/max_loras/max_cpu_loras on BaseLlmArgs are REMOVED at v1.2.1; use lora_config.* only.

guided_decoding_backend._note: v1.2.1 tightened to a Literal; v0.21 was free str.

peft_cache_config.constraint: lora_prefetch_dir not None raises ValueError 'LoRA prefetch is not supported'.

speculative_config.constraint: Dispatch is now via speculative_config.supports_backend(backend); mismatch raises ValueError. Per-class asserts on max_draft_len etc.

max_batch_size.constraint: If > max_num_tokens: warns. TorchLlmArgs.validate_misc coerces None->2048 (line 3035).

max_num_tokens._note: Default changed from null (v0.21) to 8192 at v1.2.1.

otlp_traces_endpoint._note: NEW at v1.2.1. OpenTelemetry traces target URL.

return_perf_metrics._note: Moved up from sampling-only at v0.21.

env_overrides._note: NEW at v1.2.1. Experimental env var override map; values coerced to str.

engine_params_trt._note: TrtLlmArgs(BaseLlmArgs) is the AOT TRT-engine build path. At v1.2.1 it is NO LONGER the LlmArgs alias (that is now TorchLlmArgs at line 3410). v0.21 deprecated knobs auto_parallel / auto_parallel_world_size are REMOVED.

enable_build_cache.constraint: Truthy bool coerced to BuildCacheConfig(); non-bool non-BuildCacheConfig raises ValueError.

calib_config.default_note: None coerced to CalibConfig() by before-validator (line 2655)

quant_config._note: On TrtLlmArgs quant_config is a real field; on TorchLlmArgs it is a property backed by _quant_config (line 2987).

build_config.default_note: init_build_config (line 2412) creates BuildConfig() populated from BaseLlmArgs runtime sizes.

enable_prompt_adapter._note: Moved from BaseLlmArgs (v0.21) to TrtLlmArgs at v1.2.1.

engine_params_torch._note: TorchLlmArgs(BaseLlmArgs) is the PyTorch backend (backend=='pytorch', default). LlmArgs = TorchLlmArgs (line 3410). MASSIVELY expanded vs v0.21 (21 -> 35 fields). v0.21 flat cuda_graph_* and moe_* fields are now nested into CudaGraphConfig and MoeConfig.

cuda_graph_config._note: Replaces v0.21 flat use_cuda_graph / cuda_graph_batch_sizes / cuda_graph_max_batch_size / cuda_graph_padding_enabled.

moe_config._note: Replaces v0.21 flat moe_max_num_tokens / moe_load_balancer / moe_backend.

sampler_type._note: NEW at v1.2.1; replaces v0.21 mixed_sampler / enable_trtllm_sampler booleans.

load_format.constraint: .upper() lookup in LoadFormat.__members__; missing raises ValueError. Enum now has AUTO, DUMMY, VISION_ONLY (v0.21 had only AUTO, DUMMY).

checkpoint_format.default_note: Coerced to 'HF' when both checkpoint_format and checkpoint_loader are None.

quant_config._note: On TorchLlmArgs this is a @property/@setter over PrivateAttr _quant_config, not a pydantic field. kv_cache_config.dtype=='fp8' syncs quant_config.kv_cache_quant_algo=FP8 (validator line 3180).

sampling_params._note: Dataclass(slots=True, kw_only=True). Validated in _validate (line 292). v1.2.1 ADDED top_p/top_k/temperature range checks in Python _validate (were C++-only at v0.21). AdditionalModelOutput class REMOVED; additional_model_outputs is now List[str]. NEW field prompt_ignore_length.

best_of.constraint: best_of >= n; best_of > 1 under greedy raises unless TLLM_ALLOW_N_GREEDY_DECODING set.

additional_model_outputs._note: Type CHANGED from List[AdditionalModelOutput] (v0.21) to List[str] at v1.2.1; AdditionalModelOutput class removed.

guided_decoding_params._note: Dataclass(slots=True, kw_only=True). Mutually-exclusive guide selectors enforced in _validate (line 32). UNCHANGED from v0.21 (5 fields).

CudaGraphConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. Nests the v0.21 flat TorchLlmArgs cuda_graph_* fields.

MoeConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. Nests v0.21 flat moe_* TorchLlmArgs fields.

MoeLoadBalancerConfig._note: Top-level pydantic BaseModel at v1.2.1 (was torch-internal at v0.21). num_slots must be divisible by ep_size at setup().

allowed_backends.constraint: values must be subset of {cutlass,cublaslt,cutedsl,cuda_core}; non-empty.

GuidedDecodingConfig._note: NEW top-level class at v1.2.1 (distinct from request-time GuidedDecodingParams in sampling_params.py).

RayPlacementConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. Only used with orchestrator_type=='ray'.

per_worker_gpu_share.constraint: 0 < x <= 1.0; placement_groups and placement_bundle_indices must be provided together + equal length.

KvCacheConnectorConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. All three fields required.

BaseSparseAttentionConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. from_dict dispatches by 'algorithm' key into {rocket, dsa, skip_softmax}; unknown raises ValueError.

RocketSparseAttentionConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. algorithm ClassVar='rocket'. supports_backend=='pytorch' only.

DeepSeekSparseAttentionConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. algorithm ClassVar='dsa'. supports_backend=='pytorch' only.

SkipSoftmaxAttentionConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. algorithm ClassVar='skip_softmax'. supports_backend=='pytorch' only.

KvCacheConfig._note: Pybind-mirrored (@PybindMirror.mirror_pybind_fields(_KvCacheConfig)). EXPANDED from 13 (v0.21) to 18 fields. NEW: attention_dp_events_gather_period_ms, use_uvm, max_gpu_total_bytes, dtype, mamba_ssm_cache_dtype, tokens_per_block. free_gpu_memory_fraction default is now explicit 0.9 (was null).

max_attention_window.constraint: non-empty list of positive ints if set (NEW validator at v1.2.1).

dtype._note: Pure-python field (not pybind), Pytorch backend only. NEW at v1.2.1. TrtLlmArgs asserts dtype=='auto' (validator line 2693).

tokens_per_block._note: NEW on KvCacheConfig at v1.2.1 (was only on PluginConfig at v0.21).

DynamicBatchConfig._note: Pybind-mirrored. All three fields required. UNCHANGED from v0.21.

PeftCacheConfig._note: Pybind-mirrored. UNCHANGED field set from v0.21 (12 fields); device_cache_percent/host_cache_size defaults now explicit (0.02 / 1024**3).

CacheTransceiverConfig._note: Pybind-mirrored. EXPANDED from 1 (v0.21: max_num_tokens) to 4 fields. NEW: backend enum, kv_transfer_timeout_ms, kv_transfer_sender_future_timeout_ms. v0.21 max_num_tokens renamed to max_tokens_in_buffer.

backend._note: NEW at v1.2.1. Replaces the v0.21 TRTLLM_USE_*_KVCACHE env-var-driven backend selection.

DecodingBaseConfig._note: EXPANDED from 2 (v0.21) to 11 fields. from_dict dispatches by 'decoding_type' into a 9-class registry (line 768). NEW fields incl. max_total_draft_tokens, draft_len_schedule, acceptance_window, acceptance_length_threshold.

max_total_draft_tokens._note: NEW at v1.2.1. >= max_draft_len for static/dynamic trees.

draft_len_schedule.constraint: batch_size>=1, draft_len>=0, must include {1:max_draft_len}, all draft_len<=max_draft_len.

EagleDecodingConfig._note: decoding_type ClassVar='Eagle'. EXPANDED to 11 fields. Eagle3 is handled IN-PLACE via eagle3_one_model/eagle3_layers_to_capture/eagle3_model_arch (NO separate Eagle3Config class at v1.2.1; the v0.21 instance-replacement mechanism is GONE). model_validator validate_eagle_config (line 884) requires max_draft_len; validate() requires speculative_model.

NGramDecodingConfig._note: decoding_type ClassVar='NGram'. supports_backend=='pytorch' only. v0.21 field prompt_lookup_num_tokens REMOVED (folded into max_draft_len). max_matching_ngram_size default changed 4 -> 0.

DraftTargetDecodingConfig._note: decoding_type ClassVar='Draft_Target'. supports_backend: pytorch or _autodeploy. v0.21 field pytorch_weights_path REMOVED (use speculative_model). No own fields beyond DecodingBaseConfig.

MTPDecodingConfig._note: decoding_type ClassVar='MTP'. supports_backend=='pytorch'. EXPANDED to 8 fields. NEW: use_mtp_vanilla, mtp_eagle_one_model, num_nextn_predict_layers_from_model_config, begin/end_thinking_phase_token.

mtp_eagle_one_model._note: NEW at v1.2.1. 2-model MTP deprecated in 1.3.

LookaheadDecodingConfig._note: Inherits DecodingBaseConfig + PybindMirror. decoding_type ClassVar='Lookahead'. supports_backend: NOT pytorch/_autodeploy. Defaults resolved from C++ via _LookaheadDecodingConfig.get_default_*() at class-load.

SaveHiddenStatesDecodingConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. decoding_type ClassVar='SaveState'. When active, TorchLlmArgs forces max_batch_size=1, disables overlap scheduler, nulls cuda_graph_config (validate_speculative_config line 3063).

UserProvidedDecodingConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. decoding_type ClassVar='User_Provided'. Caller supplies a Drafter instance.

AutoDecodingConfig._note: NEW at v1.2.1. decoding_type ClassVar='AUTO'. supports_backend=='pytorch'. Auto-selects a draft-model-free algorithm; no own fields beyond DecodingBaseConfig.

TorchCompileConfig._note: EXPANDED from 4 (v0.21) to 6 fields. NEW: capture_num_tokens, max_num_streams.

QuantConfig._note: Stdlib @dataclass (unchanged kind). EXPANDED from 9 (v0.21) to 10 fields (NEW mamba_ssm_cache_dtype). QuantAlgo enum grew 20 -> 26 members.

quant_algo._note: NEW members vs v0.21: W4A8_NVFP4_FP8, W4A8_MXFP4_MXFP8, W4A16_MXFP4, NVFP4_AWQ.

LoraConfig._note: MOVED from lora_manager.py (v0.21) to lora_helper.py and CONVERTED from @dataclass to pydantic BaseModel. NEW field swap_gate_up_proj_lora_b_weight. max_loras/max_cpu_loras default changed 4 -> None.

BuildConfig._note: CONVERTED from stdlib @dataclass (v0.21) to pydantic BaseModel at v1.2.1. 27 fields. v0.21 field auto_parallel_config REMOVED (auto-parallel deprecated). All other fields and defaults preserved.

BuildCacheConfig._note: Plain class with property accessors. UNCHANGED from v0.21 (3 fields).

PluginConfig._note: CONVERTED from @dataclass(slots=True)+PluginConfigMeta metaclass (v0.21) to plain pydantic BaseModel at v1.2.1. model_config=ConfigDict(validate_assignment=True, extra='ignore'). 'auto' resolution via __getattribute__ (line 297). enable/disable string coercion via wildcard before-validator (line 317). 43 user-facing fields (matching v0.21 count; explicitly_disable_gemm_plugin is now a PrivateAttr, not a public field). gemm_plugin now accepts 'nvfp4'. validate() SM-killswitch now keys on SM 100 (Blackwell, was SM 10.0 i.e. 100 at v0.21) for 5 plugins.

gemm_plugin._note: v1.2.1 added 'nvfp4' to the allowed Literal.

validate._note: Raises NotImplementedError on SM 100 (Blackwell) for gemm_swiglu_plugin, fp8_rowwise_gemm_plugin, low_latency_gemm_plugin, low_latency_gemm_swiglu_plugin, bert_context_fmha_fp32_acc when set non-False.

_source._note: All TLLM_*/TRTLLM_* env vars referenced in os.environ/os.getenv read contexts in the Python source tree under /tmp/trial_tensorrt_v1_2_1_venv/src/tensorrt_llm/. 55 unique. C++-only env vars (read inside the .so, not named in a Python os.environ read) are out of source-walk scope. See version_delta.md for the v0.21 -> v1.2.1 churn (adds/removes).

TLLM_ALLOW_N_GREEDY_DECODING.behaviour: If set, allows SamplingParams.best_of > 1 under greedy decoding.

TLLM_AUTOTUNER_CACHE_PATH.behaviour: Path for the PyTorch backend autotuner cache.

TLLM_BENCHMARK_REQ_QUEUES_SIZE.behaviour: Override the request-queue size for benchmarking.

TLLM_DISAGG_RUN_REMOTE_MPI_SESSION_CLIEN.behaviour: Use the remote MPI session client in disagg.

TLLM_LLMAPI_BUILD_CACHE.behaviour: Enable BuildCache by default for llmapi LLM() calls.

TLLM_LLMAPI_ENABLE_DEBUG._note: NEW name at v1.2.1 (cf v0.21 TLLM_LLM_ENABLE_DEBUG).

TLLM_LLMAPI_ENABLE_NVTX.behaviour: Enable NVTX range emission inside llmapi.

TLLM_LLMAPI_ZMQ_PAIR.behaviour: Use ZMQ PAIR socket for the RPC server.

TLLM_LLM_ENABLE_DEBUG.behaviour: Enable verbose debug behaviour in llmapi utils.

TLLM_OVERRIDE_LAYER_NUM.behaviour: Override the loaded model's layer count (test/small-model).
TLLM_OVERRIDE_LAYER_NUM._note: Moved file model_engine.py -> model_loader.py since v0.21.

TLLM_PP_SCHEDULER_MAX_RETRY_COUNT.behaviour: Max retry count for the PP scheduler.

TLLM_RAY_FORCE_LOCAL_CLUSTER.behaviour: Force Ray to use a local cluster.

TLLM_SPAWN_PROXY_PROCESS_IPC_ADDR.behaviour: IPC address for the spawned proxy.

TLLM_SPAWN_PROXY_PROCESS_IPC_HMAC_KEY.behaviour: HMAC key for the spawned proxy IPC.

TLLM_WORKER_USE_SINGLE_PROCESS.behaviour: Force the LLM worker to share the engine process.

TRTLLM_DEEP_EP_TOKEN_LIMIT.behaviour: Token limit for the DeepEP low-latency path.

TRTLLM_DISAGG_SERVER_DISABLE_GC.behaviour: Disable GC on the disagg server.

TRTLLM_ENABLE_ATTENTION_NVFP4_OUTPUT.behaviour: TRTLLM attention backend emits NVFP4 outputs (default on).

TRTLLM_ENABLE_PDL.behaviour: Enable Programmatic Dependent Launch in FlashInfer ops.
TRTLLM_ENABLE_PDL._note: File moved custom_ops -> flashinfer_utils since v0.21.

TRTLLM_FORCE_ALLTOALL_METHOD.behaviour: Force a specific MoE alltoall method.

TRTLLM_FORCE_COMM_METHOD.behaviour: Force a specific MoE communication method.

TRTLLM_KVCACHE_TIME_OUTPUT_PATH.behaviour: Path to write KV-cache timing output.

TRTLLM_MOE_A2A_WORKSPACE_MB.behaviour: MoE alltoall workspace size in MB.

TRTLLM_MOE_POST_QUANT_ALLTOALLV.behaviour: Apply alltoallv after post-quant in fused MoE.

TRTLLM_SERVER_DISABLE_GC.behaviour: Disable GC on the OpenAI server.

TRTLLM_WORKER_DISABLE_GC.behaviour: Disable GC on the executor worker.

TRTLLM_XGUIDANCE_LENIENT.behaviour: Lenient xgrammar/llguidance mode for json-mode eval.
